assertions.description: Sanitizer.prototype.setJavascriptURLs is a function (the mutator added alongside the SanitizerConfig member).
An explicit javascriptURLs: false survives canonicalization and is reflected by get() — never silently dropped as an unknown dictionary member.
assertions.test: (() => { if (typeof Sanitizer !== 'function') return false; const cfg = new Sanitizer({ javascriptURLs: false }).get(); return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(cfg, 'javascriptURLs') && cfg.javascriptURLs === false; })()

assertions.description: Canonicalizing a bare dictionary fills a missing javascriptURLs with the permissive default: new Sanitizer({}).get().javascriptURLs === true.
assertions.test: (() => { if (typeof Sanitizer !== 'function') return false; return new Sanitizer({}).get().javascriptURLs === true; })()

assertions.description: The built-in safe default configuration carries javascriptURLs: false — new Sanitizer('default').get().javascriptURLs === false.
assertions.test: (() => { if (typeof Sanitizer !== 'function') return false; return new Sanitizer('default').get().javascriptURLs === false; })()

assertions.description: setJavascriptURLs returns true when it changes the configuration and false when it is a no-op (spec method steps).
assertions.test: (() => { if (typeof Sanitizer !== 'function' || typeof Sanitizer.prototype.setJavascriptURLs !== 'function') return false; const s = new Sanitizer('default'); const r1 = s.setJavascriptURLs(true); const r2 = s.setJavascriptURLs(true); const r3 = s.setJavascriptURLs(false); return r1 === true && r2 === false && r3 === true && s.get().javascriptURLs === false; })()

assertions.description: With javascriptURLs: false, a javascript: URL on a navigating attribute (a href) is removed even by the unsafe method — the policy lives in the config, not the method.
assertions.test: (() => { if (typeof Element.prototype.setHTMLUnsafe !== 'function' || typeof Sanitizer !== 'function' || typeof Sanitizer.prototype.setJavascriptURLs !== 'function') return false; const host = document.createElement('div'); host.setHTMLUnsafe('x', { sanitizer: { javascriptURLs: false } }); const a = host.querySelector('a'); return !!a && !a.hasAttribute('href'); })()

assertions.description: With javascriptURLs: true, the same javascript: href survives sanitization.
assertions.test: (() => { if (typeof Element.prototype.setHTMLUnsafe !== 'function' || typeof Sanitizer !== 'function' || typeof Sanitizer.prototype.setJavascriptURLs !== 'function') return false; const host = document.createElement('div'); host.setHTMLUnsafe('x', { sanitizer: { javascriptURLs: true } }); const a = host.querySelector('a'); return !!a && /^\s*javascript:/i.test(a.getAttribute('href') || ''); })()

assertions.description: The option is scoped to the built-in navigating URL attributes list: img src (not a navigating attribute) keeps its value under javascriptURLs: false.
assertions.test: (() => { if (typeof Element.prototype.setHTMLUnsafe !== 'function' || typeof Sanitizer !== 'function' || typeof Sanitizer.prototype.setJavascriptURLs !== 'function') return false; const host = document.createElement('div'); host.setHTMLUnsafe('', { sanitizer: { javascriptURLs: false } }); const img = host.querySelector('img'); return !!img && img.hasAttribute('src'); })()
